nodes.label: Governance
nodes.question: How does the article suggest multi-level governance could contribute to the NSR?
nodes.answer: The article suggests that multi-level governance could assist in securing local effects, resolving disputes beyond trade, integrating member countries, and raising environmental sustainability within the NSR framework.

nodes.label: Management
nodes.question: How does the article suggest that multi-level governance could assist in relation to the NSR?
nodes.answer: The article suggests that multi-level governance could assist in securing local effects, resolving disputes beyond trade, integrating member countries, and raising environmental sustainability through effective governance mechanisms.

nodes.label: Governance and participation
nodes.question: Who are some of the authors associated with the terminology and concepts of governance mentioned in the paragraph?
nodes.answer: Key authors include Kooiman, Marin & Mayntz, Ansell & Gash, McQueen et al., Gonser & Schmid, Torng et al., and Evers & von Essen.
